description: To develop the ability to survey recent literature on a chosen topic in AI/ML, critically analyze it, and present the findings as a well-structured written term paper.

syllabus.title: Term Paper
syllabus.body: Selection of a contemporary topic in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning under faculty guidance, literature survey, critical analysis, and preparation of a written term paper along with its presentation.

outcomes: Independently survey and critically analyze recent literature on a chosen topic.
Develop technical writing skills through a structured term paper.
Present findings effectively to an academic audience.
